targetText:
Real wages may remain the same, they may even rise, nevertheless the
relative wages may fall.
explanation: Even if workers can afford more consumer goods due to falling production costs, their relative position compared to the capitalist class worsens if corporate profits grow much faster than wages.

targetText:
They stand in inverse proportion to each other. The share of (profit)
increases in the same proportion in which the share of labour (wages) falls,
and vice versa.
explanation: The fundamental economic law governing class struggle: profits and wages exist in an inverse mathematical relationship within the new value created by labor.
